<function name="GetRadio" parent="DMenuOption" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this <page>DMenuOption</page> should act like a radio button, set by <page>DMenuOption:SetRadio</page>.
</description>
	<added>2024.02.20</added>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="checked" type="boolean">`true` to set as a radio button.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
